questions.question: Write a Python program to perform a digital read from a GPIO pin connected to a push button. Explain how the input value is returned.
questions.solution_html:
• Program to Perform Digital Read from a GPIO Pin
  • import RPi.GPIO as GPIO
  • GPIO.setmode(GPIO.BCM)
  • GPIO.setup(17, GPIO.IN) # GPIO 17 as input (push button)
  • button_state = GPIO.input(17)
  • print("Button State:", button_state)
  • GPIO.cleanup()
  • Explanation: GPIO.input(pin) returns 1 (HIGH) when the button is pressed and 0 (LOW)
  • when released.

questions.question: Explain the port layout of Raspberry Pi 4 with the help of a neat diagram. Discuss the role of USB ports, HDMI ports, Ethernet, and GPIO pins.
questions.solution_html:
• Port Layout of Raspberry Pi 4
  • Main Points
  • - The Raspberry Pi 4 has multiple ports and connectors for interfacing, display, and power.
  • - Key Components and their Roles
  • • USB Ports – 2 × USB 3.0 (high-speed), 2 × USB 2.0 (keyboard, mouse, pen drive)
  • • HDMI Ports – Dual micro-HDMI outputs, supports dual monitors up to 4K
  • • Ethernet Port – Provides wired network connectivity (Gigabit Ethernet)
  • • GPIO Pins – 40-pin header for sensors, LEDs, actuators (Input/Output modes)
  • • Power Port – USB-C connector (5V/3A supply)
  • • Audio/Video Jack – For sound and analog video output
  • • Camera (CSI) and Display (DSI) Ports – For camera and LCD connections
  • - Purpose: Enables hardware interfacing, multimedia, and internet connectivity.
questions.final_answer: - Purpose: Enables hardware interfacing, multimedia, and internet connectivity
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
